narrative: 先展示一个系统，再从中发现一个人。观众不会被要求在看到网格、车队或容纳着躯体的沙漠之前就产生情感投入。
如果你已经处于平视高度，这就是错误的工具；如果从屋顶做一次摇臂下降（Crane Down）就能到达面部，也不该用它。高空才是起点。
how: 从真正的航拍高度开始，然后下降和/或推进，同时保持方向感清晰可辨。不要用变焦从静止的地图画面直接切换；要靠实际移动完成过渡。
提示词：aerial push in from high altitude, descending and tightening from map to person.
when: 用它从一个系统中挑出一个人。具体情境：边境沙漠，随后是一辆没有标识的警用SUV，最后是车窗里的一张脸。
不要在运镜开始时就已经是特写。
vs: 航拍拉远是相反的方向，从人物拉向地图。摇臂下降从机械臂开始，通常是从建筑高度，而不是几千英尺的高空。
定场镜头（Establishing Shot）可能只是那个静止的开场画面。航拍推近则是从地图行进到某个人的过程。
examples_film: 《边境杀手》从空中发现沙漠与边境设施中的人物。《人类之子》（Children of Men）运用从高空到地面的压迫感，把一个人定位在正在崩溃的公共空间之中。
借用的是这种“发现”的手法，而不是把政治议题当作背景装饰。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是摇臂下降，或者在静止全景上做慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）。破绽在于高度只有小摇臂的水平，或者只是光学放大而没有真正的下降。
修正方法：从高空起步，实际下降并推进，最终落在一个可辨认的人物身上。

faq.q: What is Aerial Push In in film?
faq.a: 这是一个从高空下降和/或推进的镜头，直到一个人或一辆载具在地貌或城市中变得清晰可辨。

faq.q: Aerial Push In vs Crane Down
faq.a: 摇臂下降是机械臂从局部高度下降。航拍推近则从真正的航拍高度开始，来自直升机或高空无人机，随后找到一个人。

faq.q: When should I use Aerial Push In?
faq.a: 当需要先让系统可见，再从中选定一个人时使用。如果你已经处于街道视角的主镜头（Master Shot）中，就不要用它。

faq.q: How do I prompt Aerial Push In for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写出如下要素：high aerial start, camera descends and pushes in toward [Subject], from map to person, continuous, no snap zoom.

narrative: A system is shown first, then a person is found inside it. The audience is not asked to care before they see the grid, the convoy, or the desert that contains the body.
It is the wrong tool when you are already at eye height, and the wrong tool if a crane-down from a rooftop would reach the face. Altitude is the point of origin.
how: Begin in a true aerial, then descend and/or push while keeping orientation readable. Do not snap-zoom from a still map; translate.
Prompt an aerial push in from high altitude, descending and tightening from map to person.
when: Use it to pick one human out of a system. Concrete beat: a border desert, then one unmarked police SUV, then a face in a window.
Do not start the move already on a close-up.
vs: Aerial Pullback is the reverse, person to map. Crane Down starts on an arm, usually from building height, not from thousands of feet.
An Establishing Shot may be the still first frame. Aerial push is the ride from map to someone.
examples_film: Sicario finds figures inside desert and border infrastructure from the air. Children of Men uses high-to-ground pressure so a person is located inside a collapsing public space.
Use the find, not the politics as wallpaper.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Crane Down or a Slow Zoom In on a wide still. The tell is jib height, or optical enlargement with no descent.
The fix: start at altitude, translate down and in, land on a readable person.

faq.q: What is Aerial Push In in film?
faq.a: It is a high camera that descends and/or advances until one person or vehicle becomes readable inside a landscape or city.

faq.q: Aerial Push In vs Crane Down
faq.a: Crane down is an arm descent from local height. Aerial push in begins as true aerial, from helicopter or high drone, then finds a human.

faq.q: When should I use Aerial Push In?
faq.a: When a system should be visible before a person is chosen. Do not use it if you are already in a street-level master.
